results.title: Crush The Wicked
results.overview: A detective and a vengeful survivor hunt a fugitive serial killer who resurfaces to commit one last desperate crime.

results.title: Libang Libu
results.overview: During a film shoot at a crew member's ancestral home in Perak, a production team's set is plagued by escalating trouble and eerie disruptions that threaten the entire project.

results.title: PROXY
results.overview: Clyde and his Al girlfriend, Alora, excitedly try a new service that installs Alora into a real, live, human body. But the dream becomes a nightmare when they find out the body proxies are not sourced as advertised. Now Alora is faced with a devastating choice.

results.title: Jailbroken
results.overview: A relentless, high-stakes action thriller, set entirely within a single prison cell. On the eve of his release, violent criminal Joe receives a call that shatters his world: his ex-wife and son have been kidnapped, and unless he follows the caller’s demands, they will die. Armed only with a mobile phone, Joe must race against time to save his family and himself. Ruthless prison officers only add to Joe’s woes in a razor-sharp, gripping descent into suspenseful chaos with intense emotional stakes where every second counts and freedom comes at a deadly price.

results.title: At the Place of Ghosts
results.overview: Haunted by the past, siblings Mise’l and Antle are destined to reunite and join forces against a dark spirit that emerges from their shared childhood. Once inseparable, their fractured relationship set by years of silence and a violent episode rooted in homophobia, is tested as they must return to Sk+te’kmujue’kati (the Place of Ghosts) a forest steeped in ancestral memory where time bends. What initiates from trauma soon transforms into an odyssey of healing, as Mise’l and Antle confront their caretaker’s cruelty, the weight of family secrets, and their own deepest fears.

results.title: Soul Snatchers
results.overview: A man of unwavering convictions returns with his family to the remote island of his childhood to open a music school for orphaned children, but beneath the island's beauty lies an unseen darkness.

results.title: Kraken
results.overview: In a housing project, an abandoned tower fuels rumors. As strange disappearances multiply, five young people have no choice but to enter once again. Trapped in a deadly snare, they will soon realize that escaping will be impossible…

results.title: Alphas
results.overview: A coastal community is terrorized by a school of sharks. The townspeople decide the only way to deal with the man-eating threat is to unleash a damaged killer whale held for years in solitary confinement after it killed its trainer.

results.title: Infection
results.overview: An ambitious office worker suspects her boss’s mysterious illness may be contagious. With a promotion within reach, she faces a choice between professional advancement and the person she wants to remain.

results.title: Ohh My Dog
results.overview: In Assam, 14-year-old Apu embarks on a desperate quest to rescue his beloved dog, Momo, after he is kidnapped. Elsewhere, in Bihar, a devoted dog named Oscar sets out on a perilous journey to find his kidnapped owner, a 15-year-old child labourer. As their journeys unfold, it becomes clear that the two kidnappings may be connected to a larger, sinister plan.

results.title: The Sheriff
results.overview: A local sheriff investigates a recent murder, uncovering disturbing connections to his son's unsolved death five years earlier.

results.title: Forsaken
results.overview: Everyone knows the name of Samuel Paty, but few people really know his story. On October 16, 2020, Samuel Paty, professor of History-Geography, was murdered at the end of his college. In the light of investigations and trials, this film looks back on his last eleven days, and the gear that led to his tragic death.

results.title: Kata Hati
results.overview: When a humiliated celebrity actress flees a viral public disaster and hires a reluctant e-hailing driver as her personal chauffeur to manage the fallout, their transactional arrangement blossoms into a genuine romance that threatens to shatter her carefully orchestrated public image.

results.title: Six Weeks On
results.overview: While the world is in lockdown as a result of the COVID-19 pandemic, Lore has to cope with a painful loss: her mother has died. Back in the small town of Erkelenz in North Rhine-Westphalia, she struggles against entrenched family structures and a paralyzing bureaucracy. Above all, she has to find a way to come to terms with the death and say goodbye to her mother.

results.title: The Huntsman
results.overview: When an ICU nurse volunteers to help a coma patient accused of murdering six women, he’s drawn into a chilling web of lies, obsession, and deadly secrets as a detective races to stop the killer.

results.title: Summer Cruisin'
results.overview: Eddie Summers, the lead singer of Summer Cruisin', has been missing for 38 years until his hit song, “Midnight Knows My Name,” is rediscovered on social media. Looking for a way to online fame, Sean Campbell takes it upon himself to find Eddie and put on a show that will bring him back to the top.

results.title: Sinderella
results.overview: Desperate to escape her narcissistic stepmother, a woman enters a relationship with a seeming prince charming that soon leads down a dangerous path

results.title: El Regresado
results.overview: Cuba, early 21st century. Mandi is a young art graduate who returns to his small coastal town to complete his community service. There, he must confront a local reality that clashes with his aspirations and ideals, placing him at a crossroads between avoiding confrontation within an oppressive political context and pursuing personal and artistic freedom.

results.title: O.I.C . Gadafi
results.overview: OIC Gaddafi is a Sinhala action drama based on a true story. The film follows a fearless police officer who stands up against corruption, injustice, and powerful political forces. As he fights to protect the law and ordinary people, he is drawn into dangerous conflicts that test his courage, loyalty, and sense of justice.
